vol.explainIntro: The score combines three signals about how much the price can move, on a 0–100 scale.
vol.explainVol: 50% — annualized volatility: how much the daily returns have moved over the last 6 months.
vol.explainBeta: 30% — beta: how much the stock tends to move compared to the market (1.0 = with the market).
vol.explainRange: 20% — 52-week range: the gap between the year's high and low, as a percentage.
vol.explainOutro: It measures movement, not quality — a high score is not a buy or sell signal, and a low score is not a guarantee.

explain.marketCap: The total value of all the company's shares — share price × number of shares.
explain.pe: Price-to-earnings: how many years of current profit the share price equals. A high number means investors pay more per rupee of profit.
explain.dividendYield: The annual dividend per share as a percentage of the price. A very high yield can sometimes mean the price has fallen.
explain.beta: How much the stock moves compared to the market. Above 1 moves more than the market, below 1 moves less.

scan.disclaimer: This automated scan flags warning signs, not a legal finding. It cannot verify SEBI registration — always check sebi.gov.in yourself.

GUARANTEED_RETURNS.title: Promises of guaranteed returns
GUARANTEED_RETURNS.detail: SEBI prohibits advisers from promising fixed or guaranteed returns — market returns can never be assured.

SURE_SHOT.title: “Sure shot” or “confirmed” tips
SURE_SHOT.detail: Nobody can guarantee a stock's move. “Sure shot” wording is a classic red flag SEBI warns about.

ZERO_RISK.title: Risk-free claims
ZERO_RISK.detail: Every investment carries risk. “Zero risk” or “risk free” wording is a hallmark of misleading promotions.

DOUBLE_YOUR_MONEY.title: Double-your-money promises
DOUBLE_YOUR_MONEY.detail: Quick double-money claims are a common pattern in fraudulent schemes.

CONFIRM_PROFIT.title: Confirmed-profit claims
CONFIRM_PROFIT.detail: Profits can never be confirmed in advance — SEBI prohibits advisers from claiming they can.

MULTIBAGGER.title: Multibagger hype
MULTIBAGGER.detail: Real long-term compounding takes years. “Quick multibagger” pushes are usually hype.

JACKPOT.title: Jackpot framing
JACKPOT.detail: Stocks are not lottery tickets. “Jackpot” language pushes people into reckless bets.

UPPER_CIRCUIT.title: Upper-circuit predictions
UPPER_CIRCUIT.detail: Predicting an upper-circuit move with certainty is prohibited — no one can promise a circuit limit.

ROCKET.title: “Rocket” and pump language
ROCKET.detail: Urgency language like “rocket” is common in pump-and-dump promotions.
